Name: Cherry Love
Author: CacklingxCaracal
Description:
This mod adds recipes that use Cherries! You WILL  need Parchment as a dependency as this is how you get the cookbook. The cookbook will arrive the day after you upgrade your house and get a kitchen. 

Recipes added: Cherry Pie, Cherry Cookies, Cherry Turnovers, Cherry Sauce, Shirley Temple, Cheerwine, Pancakes with Cherry Sauce, Cherry Poptart, Cherry Balsamic Vinaigrette, Michigan Oatmeal, Salad with Vinaigrette, Toast with Sauce, Cherry Ice Cream Cone, Craisin Roll, Cherry Muffin, Cherry Hazelnut Latte, Cherry Hazelnut Lava Cake, Cherry Jam Print Cookies, Cheerwine Slush, and Cherry Milkshake! 

I do NOT  allow any translation of my mod using Ai, or feeding the mod to an LLM etc.

My mods remain 100% human suffering guaranteed.
